traceability: Experimental classifier/unit crops -> existing recognizer/selector/diagnostic endpoint -> real ONNX positive/invalid/unknown/fallback tests; Staff metadata and confirmation remain authoritative; no schema or billing changes.

classifier.training: Existing38 licensed provisional TRAIN images; historical/provisional evaluation images and source groups excluded
classifier.candidate: One limited last-vision-block fine-tune; original architecture and tensor contract
classifier.selection: validation only; no wrong accepted; improve correct coverage over baseline1/7 validation
classifier.test: Existing9 are previously explored regression probes, never a new independent acceptance set

unit.allowed: Crop refinement and actual re-recognition; exact units only
unit.forbidden: Fuzzy KVA/kvVh substitution, calibration units as consumption, changing digits or OBIS code
